Researchers asked students to cut social media to thirty minutes a day.
Three weeks later, they felt less lonely, and less depressed.
If you've ever closed an app feeling smaller than when you opened it, this is for you.
You're comparing your behind-the-scenes to everyone else's highlight reel.
Their vacation. Their promotion. Their perfect morning.
You never see the doubt, the debt, or the delete button.
And the people furthest ahead of you don't inspire you. They crush you.
One. Set a thirty minute limit. Today.
Two. Unfollow five accounts that make you feel small.
Three. Follow one person who's just a few steps ahead of you.
Then compare yourself to one person only: who you were yesterday.
You're not behind. You're on a different page of a different book.
Now go unfollow the first account.
